narrative.overview: UniMark uses a quiet, familiar mobile interface that keeps attention on saved links and the actions around them. The visual system uses one restrained green accent, neutral surfaces, and the platform's default sans-serif type. Labels and controls use plain language.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color for primary actions and selected folders.
Neutral background, white cards, and subtle borders.
System sans-serif type at readable sizes and regular weights.
Compact, consistent controls with uncluttered spacing.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use green for the main action and selected state; keep routine content neutral.

dos: Do use system fonts and plain, descriptive labels.
Do keep the original URL available when a custom title is set.
Do keep touch targets at or above native accessibility guidance.
donts: Don't use decorative type or multiple competing accent colors.
Don't repeat section labels when a clear heading already communicates the content.
Don't add shadows, borders, or badges without a functional purpose.
